about: T-254: the level creator's small and long buildings. Each piece lists its art per view (rotation) and mirror: the texture, the footprint in units that view covers, and anchor_art_px, the point of the image that stands on the footprint's front corner (its bottom-right corner on the map). The art is a code-drawn placeholder (game/tools/build_creator_buildings.py draws it from this file); T-257 swaps in the final art by changing the texture paths and anchors here and rebuilding the catalogue (python game/tools/build_creator_assets.py). Labels come from creator_texts.json (label_key).
